value.rationale: The natural two-chord edge-fault question has a sharp first homotopy separation threshold at M10. At the same deletion count, adjacent chords leave a rank-two free fundamental group while distance-two chords give a contractible complex. The complete initial orbit classification and exact collapse witnesses provide a structurally motivated finite cutoff rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
